# SIRUP io

## sirup-io

Save and read SIRUP objects.

This topic also documents: `saveSIRUP`, `readSIRUP`.

`saveSIRUP` writes a SIRUP object to one RDS file. `readSIRUP` reads the file back.

```r
saveSIRUP(x, file, ...)

readSIRUP(file)
```

Arguments:

- `x`: A SIRUP object from [`createSIRUP()`](createSIRUP.md).
- `file`: Path of the RDS file. A `.sirup.rds` extension is a good choice, but any path works.
- `...`: Other arguments for [`saveRDS()`](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/base/html/readRDS.html), for example `compress`.

Value: `saveSIRUP` returns `file`, invisibly. `readSIRUP` returns the validated SIRUP object.
